name: Durabook U11I-EX
summary: The Durabook U11I-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Durabook rugged 11.6-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T135°C Dc
atex.status: ATEX certificate of conformity number quoted in the user manual (ATEX file ATEX-U11I-EX, R2, 2025-08-01); status not independently checked; no IECEx; UKEX not found

safety.conditions: Must be used with the ATEX case supplied by Twinhead, packed as the manual describes. Must not be connected to any external device. Battery may only be charged in a safe area with the supplied adapter (FSP065-RBBN3, 19 V, 3.42 A, 65 W). Do not replace or charge the battery in explosive environments. Do not use the device without the ATEX case in explosive environments. Use only Japone Technology X11BA-H (9600 mAh) or X11BA-M (4800 mAh) batteries.
safety.peripherals: Per the manual: the tablet shall not be connected to any external device. All I/O ports are covered by explosion-proof brackets that must be fitted (with screws) before entering the ATEX area. The anti-static leather case is mandatory.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Supplied with the Ex tablet and part of the certification: ATEX anti-static leather case, bottom bracket and screws, stylus and tether. AC adapter and power cord for the safe area only. The datasheet lists 2-bay and 8-bay chargers, hand strap, shoulder straps, tablet stand and other accessories without Ex status; none is named as Ex-certified.

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
